notes: Registry metadata is not a certification that every listed problem remains open.
Each imported status must carry a fresh primary-source verification timestamp.
License and robots/API constraints must be reviewed before automated ingestion.

sources.name: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Problems
sources.refresh_policy: refresh before every public status claim
sources.status_policy: verify current status and exact statement from the primary page
sources.license_note: Store metadata, citations and concise paraphrases unless reuse permission is confirmed.

sources.name: Erdős Problems
sources.status_policy: verify open, solved, disproved and reward status against cited literature
sources.license_note: Respect site terms and preserve attribution to problem editors and references.

sources.name: American Institute of Mathematics Problem Lists
sources.refresh_policy: refresh list and linked workshop pages before import
sources.status_policy: verify statement version and current status from list maintainers or literature
sources.license_note: Store provenance and links; do not republish full copyrighted lists without permission.

sources.name: Ben Green's 100 Open Problems
sources.refresh_policy: refresh against the latest author version and cited updates

sources.license_note: Keep concise metadata, page references and attribution; avoid reproducing the PDF.

sources.name: Formal Conjectures
sources.status_policy: verify formal statement, source provenance and open status independently
sources.license_note: Follow repository license and retain commit SHA plus original source references.

sources.name: Open Quantum Problems
sources.refresh_policy: refresh problem and solved-problem pages before status claims
sources.status_policy: verify status, version, date and references from the catalog and literature
sources.license_note: Preserve attribution and do not mirror full entries without permission.

sources.name: On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences
sources.refresh_policy: refresh sequence revision and comments before conjecture extraction
sources.status_policy: verify conjecture wording and cited literature; comments are not proof
sources.license_note: Comply with OEIS contribution and data-use terms; retain sequence IDs and attribution.

sources.name: International Mathematical Olympiad

sources.status_policy: verify year, problem number, official statement and solution availability
sources.license_note: Use as training/evaluation metadata; respect copyright on statements and solutions.

sources.name: William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition
sources.status_policy: verify official year, session, problem and published solution source
sources.license_note: Use metadata and links unless redistribution rights are confirmed.

sources.name: COMAP MCM/ICM
sources.refresh_policy: refresh schedule, rules and problem releases each cycle
sources.status_policy: verify active cycle, deadlines, eligibility and statement publication
sources.license_note: Competition statements and data may have restricted reuse; store links and metadata.

sources.name: International Collegiate Programming Contest
sources.refresh_policy: refresh contest calendar and regional archives each cycle
sources.status_policy: verify event, eligibility, statement version and judge data availability
sources.license_note: Respect contest and archive licenses; do not redistribute judge data without permission.

sources.name: Kaggle Competitions
sources.status_policy: verify deadlines, rules, teams, data license and external-data policy
sources.license_note: Each competition has distinct rules and data licenses; never assume reuse rights.

sources.name: ARC Prize
sources.refresh_policy: refresh rules, tracks and deadlines for the current cycle
sources.status_policy: verify current competition state, evaluation protocol and open-source obligations
sources.license_note: Retain rule-version provenance and comply with submission and code-release terms.

sources.name: AI Mathematical Olympiad Prize
sources.refresh_policy: refresh current tracks, datasets and deadlines
sources.status_policy: verify current phase, eligibility, benchmark version and licensing
sources.license_note: Respect benchmark, model and submission licenses.

sources.name: MathOverflow open-problem discussions
sources.refresh_policy: refresh the question, edits and answers before use
sources.status_policy: verify any claimed open status against primary literature and expert sources
sources.license_note: Content is community-authored under site licensing; preserve attribution and links.

sources.name: Open Problem Garden
sources.refresh_policy: refresh entry and cited references before activation
sources.status_policy: verify current status independently; community entries may be stale
sources.license_note: Respect site terms and contributor attribution.

sources.name: Tristan internal theorem programs
sources.refresh_policy: refresh from the exact repository commit before compilation
sources.status_policy: verify that every item is labeled hypothesis, prototype, benchmark or theorem
sources.license_note: Apply repository license, IPGate and OAK publication review before external release.
